questions.text:
Choose ONE media genre and society. (Note: 'Society' refers to a community in a specific time and place, or the audience for a genre.)

Write an essay discussing the extent to which you agree with ONE of the statements below. Respond critically to the statement by evaluating the influence, impact, and wider significance of a relationship between your chosen media genre and society.

STATEMENTS (Choose ONE):
1. A new genre can signal a shift in cultural values.
2. Genre reveals how communities once understood themselves.
3. Genre mirrors the power structures of its era.
4. Public conversation shapes the boundaries of a genre.
5. Genre illuminates what a society prefers to overlook.

You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 5-6 pages. The quality of your writing is more important than the length of your essay. Make sure you respond only to your chosen statement throughout your essay, and include relevant, specific supporting detail from a range of media texts.

You must specify your chosen media genre, society, and statement number on the planning page.
questions.markingGuide:
This is a holistic essay marked on a scale from N0 to E8.

Achievement (A3-A4): Demonstrate understanding by explaining a relationship between a media genre and society. Use some detailed (A3) or detailed (A4) evidence from a range of media texts. Address the chosen statement some of the time (A3) or generally throughout the response (A4).

Merit (M5-M6): Demonstrate in-depth understanding by analysing a relationship between a media genre and society by explaining its impact on the genre and/or society. Focus on the genre, using detailed evidence from a range of media texts and/or secondary sources. Address the chosen statement throughout the response with some nuance (M6).

Excellence (E7-E8): Demonstrate perceptive understanding by evaluating the impact of a relationship between a media genre and society. E7 draws convincing conclusions about the wider significance. E8 shows a perceptive and engaging understanding. Focus on the genre, using relevant, insightful detail from a range of primary and secondary sources. E7 interrogates the chosen statement with nuance. E8 interrogates with nuance throughout.

N0 = No response; no relevant evidence.
